name: copilotkit
summary: I successfully scaffolded the Next.js app (`npx create-next-app` completed with "Success! Created my-copilot-app"), installed the CopilotKit packages (`npm install @copilotkit/react-core @copilotkit/runtime` added 1167 packages), and wired up the runtime route, layout provider, and page component exactly as the quickstart specifies. However, the build was blocked by the sandbox's 1 GB cgroup memory limit: `npx next build` was repeatedly killed with exit code 137 (SIGKILL/OOM) during "Creating an optimized production build," and `cat /sys/fs/cgroup/memory.max` confirmed the hard limit is `1073741824` bytes. The app could not be built or served, so I could not verify the working copilot endpoint.

installed.evidence: added 1167 packages, and audited 1533 packages in 1m
